author: SoyErick
quote: A completely mediocre game. It fails to evolve or innovate in any meaningful way, feeling entirely stagnant from start to finish. Pretty disappointing.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: SoyErick
quote: An incredible game! I absolutely love the radio, the animations are amazing, and the dialogue is an absolute gem. Easily one of my favorite experiences.
